source_evidence: Exact player 'Unfortunately I can’t. My weapon is part of my authority. And reveal the silver sword' refuses disarmament and deliberately displays the existing floating inherited silver sword at the open receiving threshold. No new supernatural ability, expenditure, attack or identity test. The warder had previously seen the sword; this is a closer deliberate display, not first sight. Cirren independently corroborates the party's actual historical investigation and documentary provenance without claiming verified parentage. Meaningful Help, V Persuasion advantage +7, predeclared DC16 for armed entry only. Actual executed Python secrets receipt batch e35d17a752e8959e5fb097edfe3ec4cf, d20 faces20,4; 20+7=27 succeeds. Natural20 not automatic skill success; total exceeds DC. The warder makes a limited concession: steps aside to (5,5), permits V and companions to enter armed under observation, temporarily addresses V as Viscount out of courtesy/provisional credence, not verified dynastic recognition, supernatural authority, loyalty, formal surrender or relinquishing custody. No recognition of particular sword provenance assumed. First receiving skeletons remain fixed positions. The warder remains armed and protective of guarded possessions, will resist unauthorized removal. No V or companion entry presumed until V chooses; no attack, initiative, new evidence/copy, or feature expenditure. No new title/quest success. Day331~16:31.
